Carefully analyze the scenario and take the perspective of the individual involved.
Then, select the option that best reflects their perspective or emotional response.

# Output


## Scenario
Ronaldo's best friend tells him that he intends to go on a road trip with his other friends, leaving him behind.

## Question 
In this scenario, what is the most effective Response for Ronaldo?

## Choices
A) "I appreciate the invite but I can't make it. Hope you guys have fun!"
B) "Well, have fun with your friends and I'll have fun with mine"
C) "That sounds fun, I hope you'll have a great time"
D) "I see! Well, pity that I didn't come to mind"
